configurations.name: forsight-agent
runtimeArgs: cd forsight && exec ./bin/forsight run --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --disable-docker --store badger --data-dir "$HOME/.forsight" --retention 168h --probe mlaas=http://127.0.0.1:8090/healthz --mlaas-url http://127.0.0.1:8090 --mlaas-api-key-file "$HOME/.mlaas-data/api_key"
